page: Amazon Web Services c8id.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with a dedicated Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor running at 3.9 GHz. The system provides 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by a 480 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio.

This instance includes 1900 GB of local NVMe SSD instance store volumes, offering high-speed local storage directly attached to the hypervisor. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps. The CPU architecture supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE, AMX_INT8), alongside cryptographic acceleration via VAES and SHA_NI.

In benchmark evaluations, the c8id.8xlarge demonstrates strong performance in single-threaded and multi-threaded operations. It achieves top-tier results in Geekbench text processing and small-model LLM text generation, reaching 371.41 tokens per second. Single-threaded gzip compression and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression also rank in the strong tier. The instance is well-suited for compute-intensive workloads, local database operations, software compilation, and medium-scale language model inference.
